origin.missingFromNominalBudget: Uncertainty in one calibration is shared by the run. A nominal per-trial value alone cannot bound the chance across plausible calibrations.

operation.calculation: Choose the longest mean lifetime, smallest absolute detector acceptance, smallest selected exit weight and largest competing weights. Use the existing run planner at that corner.

limits: A conditional minimum over the declared box for the same independent-trial model at each fixed calibration. Reported error bars used as endpoints do not give coverage for the box. Shared calibration drift or correlated trial outcomes require other models.
